title: Digital Art in GIMP
description: GIMP is a powerful, free, and open-source image editing software used by artists, designers, and photographers worldwide. In this series of beginner-friendly tutorials, you’ll learn how to navigate the GIMP interface, work with layers and selections, and explore essential tools for digital painting, photo editing, and graphic design. These tutorials are designed to build your confidence in 2D digital art while encouraging creativity, experimentation, and play.
